A gothic vampire saga is brought to life on Unreal Engine 5. It's a brilliant idea that deserves a better delivery than what PS5 and Xbox consoles are offering today. The Blood of Dawnwalker gives you the option of 30fps/40fps modes with uneven frame pacing, or 60fps with drops - and cut back settings in that case too. It's a tricky choice to make, and Tom has done the leg-work to show all the pros and cons for each.
